Title: Public Preview: NUnit support in Microsoft Playwright Testing

Body.Content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Microsoft Playwright Testing supports the NUnit test runner. This feature is now in preview. C# developers can now seamlessly run NUnit-based tests with Microsoft Playwright Testing to streamline continuous integration (CI) workflows with a unified dashboard and scalable cloud browsers. NUnit support enables C# developers to accelerate build pipelines by running more tests in parallel, improve test coverage by running across multiple OS-browser combinations, and troubleshoot efficiently with rich reporting that consolidates all results and artifacts in a unified portal. 

Learn more.
